Heavy equipment servicing in Victoria

Speak with heavy equipment mechanic Clive Sampson about servicing and maintenance across Victoria. Discuss your machinery, operating hours and work requirements directly.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Plan maintenance around your equipment

Working machinery needs maintenance planning that reflects its use, operating hours and service history. Share the machine make, model, serial number and available records with Clive, together with the work required.

Discuss the manufacturer service schedule, known issues and preferred maintenance dates. The machine type and proposed work help establish a suitable service arrangement.

Information to have ready

  • Machine make, model, serial number and engine details if known.
  • Current operating hours and the last service record.
  • Warning messages, leaks, unusual noises or changes in operation.
  • Site location, equipment access and any site entry requirements.
  • Preferred dates and any limits on equipment downtime.

Describe the symptoms you have noticed. You do not need to identify the cause before making an enquiry.

Field service and component work

For machinery at a worksite, call to discuss whether field service is suitable for the work required. Safe access, the fault and equipment requirements affect the arrangements. Attendance, travel and timing are confirmed directly with Clive.

For an assembly requiring separate assessment, see component rebuilding. For maintenance across several machines, discuss fleet and equipment maintenance.

Melbourne and regional Victoria

Sampson Heavy Diesel Services takes heavy equipment enquiries across Victoria. Provide the site address, suburb or nearest town, along with the machine details. Find your Victorian locality or postcode, then call to discuss the job.

Confirm the scope, location, timing and applicable charges before work is arranged.
